backup_process.integrity_repair_engine: repairBackupIntegrity.ts auto-scans GZIP headers, repairs corrupted archives, and synchronizes SHA-256 digests in backup_manifest.json.

recovery_steps: 1. Identify valid backup ID from backup_manifest.json
2. Execute restore CLI script: npx tsx -e 'import { restoreBackup } from "./src/server/backupEngine"; restoreBackup(id);'
3. Run repair and verification CLI: npx tsx repairBackupIntegrity.ts
4. Restart API server: npm run build && npm start

data_protection_rules: AES-256 encryption for PII fields (NID numbers, bank details, passwords).
SHA-256 cryptographic hashes for backup manifest validation.
TLS 1.3 encryption in transit for all client-server communications.
PII masking on non-privileged administrative screens.
Append-only immutable record versioning for legal deeds and documents.
Strict prohibition of soft-deletes on financial ledgers and vouchers.
deployment_steps: 1. Clone source repository and configure environment variables in .env.
2. Run npm install to install dependencies.
3. Run npm run lint to verify TypeScript syntactic integrity.
4. Run npm run build to compile Vite frontend and esbuild server bundle to dist/server.cjs.
6. Deploy to Google Cloud Run with 2GB RAM, 2 vCPUs, and host binding 0.0.0.0:3000.

environment_variables.description: Google Cloud Storage bucket name for offsite backup replication.
